__inputs.name: DS_INFINITY
__inputs.label: Infinity
__inputs.description: Infinity data source, which reads the CSV

options.content: The three queries of the panel hold their CSV inline: **devices**, **racks** and **alerts**. To read your own files, edit a query, set **Source** to **URL** and give the URL of the CSV file. Keep the typed columns: numbers for the positions, heights and values, **string** for `is_full_depth` and `desc_units`. The columns are described in the [data contract](https://github.com/Kentrow/grafana-rackelevation-panel/blob/main/src/README.md#data-contract).
